title: Thais
text: Thais at The Spencer in Dublin was exceptional in her ability to make us feel welcome and glad we chose The Spencer as a place to stay.  She took time to chat with us even though The Pantry was bustling with breakfast guests. And as a sidenote the breakfast is simply amazing! We realized this was standard practice for Spencer employees as Thais demonstrated the same courtesy and professionalism as her colleagues.  She is exceptional and The Spencer is even more of a gem because of her extra attention to guests.

title: Absolutely the best Thai spa in Vizag! I had an amazing experience at Buddha Thai Spa. The ambiance is calm, clean, and
text: Absolutely the best Thai spa in Vizag! I had an amazing experience at Buddha Thai Spa. The ambiance is calm, clean, and truly relaxing. I opted for the traditional Thai massage, and the therapist was highly professional and well-trained. You can really feel the difference in quality compared to other spas in Visakhapatnam.
